claims.claim: ReFolDec defines four canonical representations and legal/deferred fold boundaries.
claims.consequence: Downstream organs could invent incompatible representations or direct folds.
claims.next_test: Require organ conformance reports against the matrix.

claims.claim: The semantic registry is machine-readable, color-agnostic, and mechanically validated.
claims.consequence: Consumers could drift in role names or bind private palette values upstream.
claims.next_test: Run parity checks in each consuming organ.

claims.claim: The fold contract's invariants are testable without building a runtime.
claims.consequence: Prose guarantees remain ambiguous to implementers.
claims.next_test: Apply the validator to a second fixture.

claims.claim: One synthetic workflow can be traced through all four forms with preserved invariants.
claims.consequence: The public proof could overstate general codec capability.
claims.next_test: Repeat the comparison on an unseen fixture.

claims.claim: The local skill library is release-ready and improves agent outcomes.
claims.consequence: Users could mistake structural package health for measured task-quality uplift.
claims.next_test: Run isolated current-version treatment/control evaluations with a protected holdout.

claims.claim: All named ecosystem organs currently conform to the head contracts.
claims.consequence: Placeholder links and planned organs could be presented as verified dependencies.
claims.next_test: Obtain owner-approved parity reports from each organ.

claims.claim: A codec runtime or direct Diagram ↔ Agent-Executable fold is ready to implement.
claims.consequence: A premature runtime could bake in uncontracted semantics.
claims.next_test: Approve a contract revision with an intermediate representation first.

claims.claim: The current Foundry 3.1.0 package completed a matched live evaluation on four public development cases, but the release quality gate and protected holdout requirement remain unmet.

confirmed: Exact-version public-development runs and blinded grading are recorded.
inferred: The observed public-case difference is sample-specific and not a general uplift claim.
proposed: Independent execution of the external holdout is the next release gate.
unknown: Unseen-case performance, cross-host portability, and production readiness.
